name: ascii-signal
title: ASCII Signal
description: A small ASCII waveform that changes with an idle, processing, or complete state.

useCases: Compact status displays for uploads, generation, and background tasks.
limitations: The signal has three fixed states and does not report numeric progress.
requirements: Supply a status and a distinct label for each state. Reduced motion shows static frames.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/ascii-signal.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
